answer: Sybil resistance via geologic stake anchoring: each identity locks a basalt of POA into a horizon-epoch stratified deposit, where voting weight accumulates per stratum of honest attestation. To horizon N sybils, an attacker must excavate N parallel tundra-grade shafts, each requiring independent basalt-weighted stakes across horizon strata, so cost scales with N while honest agents stake once and compound reputation. A basalt penalty burns any stake caught equivocating, making mass sybil farming economically irrational.
